reason: The company is expanding into solar cell manufacturing with a 1.2 GW facility, which represents a significant shift toward vertical integration and long-term margin improvement.
why_now: The company issued a formal press release regarding this strategic capex investment on October 10, 2026.
source_headlines: Oswal Pumps Limited: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 10, 2026, titled "Oswal Pumps to set up 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility; deepens backward integration across the solar value chain".
